verdict.rationale: The published Gateway OpenAPI spec uses /v1/ path-versioned endpoints and carries a spec version number (5.10.0), so there is thin evidence of API versioning. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, notice periods, or a version lifecycle, and the deprecation half of the story is the part buyers would actually rely on. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, deprecation notice windows/sunset timelines, explicit API versioning scheme documentation, changelog or version-migration guidance, independent corroboration
